name: http-parser
input_api: http_parser_init(..., HTTP_REQUEST); http_parser_execute(..., local request bytes, length); on_url and on_headers_complete callbacks
family: Node http-parser C state machine, predecessor design to llhttp
scope: HTTP/1.1 GET request method, target and version after complete header parse

name: picohttpparser
license_evidence: Pinned release README dual-license statement (MIT or Perl License)
input_api: phr_parse_request(local request bytes, length, method/path/version/header outputs)
family: PicoHTTPParser C request parser, used by H2O
scope: HTTP/1.1 GET request method, target and version after complete header parse

name: mongoose
license_evidence: Pinned release LICENSE dual-license text; GPL-2.0 open-source option
input_api: mg_http_parse(const char *local request bytes, size_t len, struct mg_http_message *out)
family: Mongoose C HTTP request parser; related to CivetWeb and LibHTTP ancestry
scope: HTTP/1.1 GET request method, target, query and version

name: libmicrohttpd
license_evidence: Pinned GNU source COPYING and src/microhttpd/daemon.c license header
input_api: MHD_start_daemon(MHD_USE_NO_LISTEN_SOCKET | MHD_USE_INTERNAL_POLLING_THREAD, ...); MHD_add_connection(daemon, local socketpair stream, ...); access handler receives parsed method, URL, version and MHD_lookup_connection_value returns parsed query
family: GNU libmicrohttpd HTTP/1 request parser in an embedded C server, separate from llhttp and PicoHTTPParser
scope: HTTP/1.1 GET request method, path, query argument and version from local socket stream

name: libwebsockets
input_api: lws_create_context in no-listen server mode; lws_adopt_socket_vhost_readbuf(vhost, local socketpair fd, local HTTP request bytes, length); LWS_CALLBACK_HTTP and parsed header/query accessors
family: libwebsockets C HTTP/1 parser in the server adoption path; independent from llhttp and LibHTP
scope: HTTP/1.1 GET request method, path, query argument and Host header from local read buffer
harness_note: The Docker harness accepts at most 2048 initial bytes, the documented limit of lws_adopt_socket_vhost_readbuf; larger inputs are rejected before parsing.

name: libsoup
license_evidence: Pinned release meson.build license declaration and COPYING
input_api: soup_headers_parse_request(local request-head bytes excluding trailing blank line, length, SoupMessageHeaders, method, path, version)
family: GNOME libsoup 3 HTTP/1 request-head parser, independent from llhttp and PicoHTTPParser
scope: HTTP/1.1 GET request-head method, target, version and Host header from local byte buffer

name: serf
license_evidence: Pinned Apache source LICENSE and serf_bucket_types.h license header
input_api: serf_bucket_simple_create(local response bytes); serf_bucket_response_create(stream); serf_bucket_response_status/wait_for_headers/get_headers and serf_bucket_read
family: Apache Serf C HTTP/1 response bucket state machine; independent from libsoup and llhttp
scope: HTTP/1.1 response status, reason, Content-Type, Content-Length and body from local byte buffer

name: facil-legacy
license_evidence: Pinned release root LICENSE and http1_parser.h header
input_api: http1_parse(http1_parser_s *, local writable request bytes, length); method, path, query, version, header and request-complete callbacks
family: facil.io 0.7 HTTP/1 parser, earlier distinct distribution and API of the facil.io family later developed as C STL 0.8; these two package paths share lineage
scope: HTTP/1.1 GET request method, path, query, version and Host header after complete local-byte parse

name: libhv
license_evidence: Pinned release root LICENSE; bundled http_parser.c and http_parser.h carry the Node/Joyent MIT notice
input_api: Bundled public C http_parser_init(HTTP_REQUEST), http_parser_execute(parser, callbacks, local request bytes, length), and http_method_str; on_url and on_headers_complete callbacks
family: libhv bundles a modified Node http-parser 2.9.1 C engine; separate tagged library distribution but shared parser family with Node http-parser 2.9.4, not an independent engine
scope: HTTP/1.1 GET request method, target and version after complete header parse from local bytes

name: h2o
license_evidence: Pinned H2O root LICENSE and bundled deps/picohttpparser/README.md MIT option
input_api: H2O-bundled PicoHTTPParser phr_parse_request(local request bytes, length, method, path, version, headers); the pinned H2O distribution documents and ships the C API
family: H2O 2.2.6 bundles PicoHTTPParser as its HTTP/1 parser; separate tagged H2O package distribution but same underlying parser family as h2o/picohttpparser 1.5, not an independent engine
scope: HTTP/1.1 GET request method, target, version and headers from local byte buffer via H2O-bundled parser
